title: Kitfo Tibs
description: Ethiopian-style raw ground beef dish with spices and cheese. A hearty and cheesy twist on traditional kitfo.

ingredients.name: raw ground beef
ingredients.notes: High-quality, lean ground beef is best for this dish.

ingredients.name: niter kibbeh (ethiopian clarified butter)
ingredients.notes: You can make your own niter kibbeh by clarifying the butter with spices and salt.

ingredients.name: chopped onion
ingredients.notes: Use a sweet onion like Vidalia for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Cilantro adds a bright, fresh flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: grated cheese (such as cheddar or mozzarella)
ingredients.notes: The cheese adds a rich, creamy element to the dish.

ingredients.name: ground ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate the ginger on a microplane for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: ground cumin
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality cumin for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for the best flavor.

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, niter kibbeh, onion, cilantro, cheese, ginger, cumin, and salt. Mix everything together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, use your hands to shape the mixture into small patties.
Serve the kitfo tibs chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve with injera bread or over couscous for a more substantial meal.
Be sure to handle the raw ground beef safely and cook the kitfo to the correct internal temperature for food safety.
